title: The Homecoming of Route 9
author: Kestrel Zhou
blurb: Isandro Oyelaran, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
